targets.failed_criterion_note: C1 (load-bearing) fails only via a worst-of-3-seed readiness-precondition veto (replay_high_value_candidate_available), not because the AND-gate's own decision logic misfired in any tested cell.

biological_reference.closest_mechanism: hippocampal-striatal offline replay driving sleep-dependent motor-sequence consolidation (Albouy 2013); striatal chunk formation via DLS plasticity (Graybiel 1998/2008, Smith & Graybiel 2013)
biological_reference.divergence: MECH-322 was registered precisely because biology does NOT cleanly gate the chunking write path the way ARC-071's original strict pre-registration assumed -- load-bearing biology divergence, already resolved at registration (2026-05-11 R6 decision), not newly discovered by this autopsy.

targets.recommended_evidence_direction_note: 2/2 valid-precondition seeds gave a clean positive result (minted with replay_origin=True); 1/3 correctly withheld per design. Leaning-supports pending a corrected re-run, not a genuine weakening.
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-08-03 failure autopsy, V3-EXQ-873, confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-873_2026-08-03]: FIRST experimental test of MECH-322. The load-bearing criterion (C1) reads FAIL only because a worst-of-3-seed readiness precondition (a real high-value candidate must naturally emerge by a fixed sleep checkpoint) failed in 1/3 seeds; in the other 2/3, the AND-gate minted a replay_origin=True chunk exactly as specified, and every fail-closed branch tested (wake-refusal, master-switch-off, low-value, no-candidate) passed cleanly across all 9 cells. This is a test-design defect (an overly strict worst-of-N-seed aggregation conflating a stochastic precondition with a deterministic plumbing check), not a substrate ceiling or claim weakening -- read as evidence_direction=mixed leaning supports pending a corrected re-run. Route: /queue-experiment V3-EXQ-873a with a decoupled, fraction-based readiness gate and 6-8 seeds. No claim-status change; v3_pending stays True pending the corrected re-run.
learning_extracted: MECH-322's AND-gate (ChunkAccumulator.record_replay_sequence) mints correctly under genuine valid conditions and fails closed correctly under every invalid condition tested across all 9 cells -- positive-leaning evidence, not a null result.

The experiment's own test design conflates a stochastic readiness precondition (candidate availability by a fixed checkpoint episode) with the deterministic criterion it is meant to gate, at SEED_PASS_FRACTION=1.0 -- a measurement/test-design gap, not a substrate or claim problem.
Recording is complete (validate_recording.py OK); not a recording-debt case.

Shared structural property with V3-EXQ-882 (MECH-472, unrelated claim): a worst-of-N=3-seed readiness gate lets one hard/unlucky seed veto a whole arm/run's adjudication even though clearing seeds are independently informative -- see cluster_pattern.

cluster_pattern.structural_property: A within-arm, cross-seed worst-case reduction (each driver's own local _worst()-style helper, applied before calling experiments/_lib/precondition_gate.py's evaluate_arm_gate) treats a naturally stochastic readiness precondition as if it required deterministic 100% clearance across all N=3 seeds. One hard/unlucky seed then zeroes the entire arm/run's adjudication, burying informative data from the seeds that did clear (a clean confirming result in V3-EXQ-873; a stable difficulty-diagnostic split in V3-EXQ-882). Distinct from the arm-vs-arm vacating defect precondition_gate.py already closes (V3-EXQ-785) -- that fix is cross-arm; this pattern is within-arm, cross-seed, and the shared library is agnostic to it. Both drivers are among 55 in the corpus using precondition_gate.py, so this convention is plausibly common elsewhere.
